Class PagePaint

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.ssh.shell.PagePaint
final class PagePaint extends Object
The PagePaint class builds the bytes that take the screen from one input page to the next. A glyph edit rewrites the damaged tail and returns that rewrite as one string. Erase-to-end of the screen stays off this path. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#PagePaint // @aa-sdd G-22 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Method Details

    • update

      static PagePaint.Patch update(String beforeText, int beforeCursor, int screenRow, int screenCol, String afterText, int afterCursor, int promptVis, int cols, boolean commandGreen)
      The update method builds one flush from the text already on screen to the text the screen should show. A null text is treated as empty. Equal texts move the cursor and do not rewrite glyphs. Unequal texts rewrite from the first damaged index. A hard newline erases to the end of the line before the row break. A wrap that is not a hard newline does not erase that line. Extra rows that the old page still has are deleted. The cursor then moves to the landing cell.
      Parameters:
      beforeText - The before text is the text already on screen.
      beforeCursor - The before cursor is the cursor index already on screen.
      screenRow - The screen row is the cursor row inside that page.
      screenCol - The screen column is the cursor column inside that page.
      afterText - The after text is the text the screen should show.
      afterCursor - The after cursor is the cursor index to land on.
      promptVis - The prompt width is the number of visible prompt columns.
      cols - The column count is the wrap width.
      commandGreen - The flag is true when each echoed glyph is wrapped in command green.
      Returns:
      The return value is the patch.

    • damageIndex

      private static int damageIndex(String before, String after, InputPage beforePage, InputPage afterPage)
      The method returns the first index where the texts or their row breaks differ. The scan stops at the shorter length. Equal texts return that shared length.
      Parameters:
      before - The before text is the text already on screen.
      after - The after text is the text the screen should show.
      beforePage - The before page is the measurement of the old text.
      afterPage - The after page is the measurement of the new text.
      Returns:
      The return value is the first damaged buffer index.

    • clamp

      private static int clamp(int index, int length)
      The method clamps an index into a cell array. A negative index becomes 0. An index at or past the length becomes the last cell.
      Parameters:
      index - The index is the requested cell.
      length - The length is the number of cells.
      Returns:
      The return value is an index inside the array.

    • moveTo

      private void moveTo(int targetRow, int targetCol)
      The method appends the cursor motion from the current cell to the target cell. A larger row number moves the cursor down. A smaller row number moves the cursor up. The same column stops there. A move to the right on the same row uses cursor-forward. A move to the left on the same row uses cursor-back. Any other column returns to column 0 and then moves forward.
      Parameters:
      targetRow - The target row is the visual row to land on.
      targetCol - The target column is the visual column to land on.

    • glyph

      private void glyph(char c)
      The method appends one character. Command green wraps the character in green and then resets the color.
      Parameters:
      c - The character is the glyph to write.

    • el

      private void el()
      The method appends erase-to-end-of-line. The sequence is Ansi.EL.

    • newLine

      private void newLine()
      The method appends a carriage return and a line feed. The painter then sits at column 0 of the next row.
